title.en: An act creating Two (2) additional branches of the Municipal Trial Court in cities in the City of Tagbilaran, amending for the purpose Section Twenty-Nine of Batas Pambansa Bilang Isang Daan Dalawampu’t Siyam (BP 129), otherwise known as the Judiciary Reogganization Act of 1980, and appropriating funds thereof

text.en: The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice shall immediately include in the Court’s program the operationalization of the two (2) additional municipal trial court branches in the city of Calamba, Laguna, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
